title: fix(cli): os dev on a host config serves the artifact its STALE warning describes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9MdNg5yjRFp5bqwxMTsw1wi)_
Fixes #31761

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The dev behaviour change is declared below and in the changeset: on `os dev` over a host config, `--no-compile` with a stale artifact now serves the artifact for every type (it served a source/artifact mix), and the ready banner row reads `Artifact: dist/objectstack.json`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os dev` 跑「宿主型配置」(`plugins[]` 里放了插件实例，空白脚手架就是)时，应用改为从编译产物 `dist/objectstack.json` 注册，配置模块只补 `onEnable`/`functions` 这类 JSON 装不下的代码成员；与非宿主配置本来的装配一致。
- 为什么改：以前同一次启动里有两份元数据：视图和公开表单答的是改过的源码，对象答的是旧产物，而 `--no-compile` 打印的「STALE build」警告两头都不对(卡 #31761 实测)。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `os dev` + 宿主配置 + 产物在盘这一条路径;默认编译下三处条目改以编译后形态出现(见 Accepted deviations),行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 wrap 一段(`loadArtifactBundle` + `graftAuthoredRuntimeMembers([wrap], config)`);`packages/cli/test/dev-host-config-artifact-source.integration.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`cd packages/cli && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/dev-host-config-artifact-source.integration.test.ts`,预期 13 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`, one composition decision. When the dev artifact door composes (a host config under `os dev`, artifact on disk), the `AppPlugin` wrap is built over the door's FILE (`loadArtifactBundle(path, { unwrapEnvelope: true })`) instead of the config module, and the module's runtime members (`STACK_RUNTIME_MEMBERS`: `onEnable`, `functions`) are grafted onto that one wrap with the existing `graftAuthoredRuntimeMembers`. That is the composition `createStandaloneStack` already gives a non-host config (door + `AppPlugin` over the same artifact + graft), so after this every `os dev` boot serves one copy. It finishes what the #12892 ruling (the door owns the registration route) started for the four security collections.

- An artifact that fails to load falls back to the module wrap, as before (`loadArtifactBundle` already says why).
- The orphaned-runtime-member warning moved into a local helper shared by both graft sites; its text is unchanged.
- `configBootBundle` is set on that boot, so the ready banner names the artifact (the #21501 row rule: no row names a file the boot did not load). Docblocks on `configBootBundle` and `resolveBannerConfigRow` updated to say so.
- `dev.ts`'s STALE warning is untouched: it is now true as written.

Unchanged paths: `os serve` / `os start` on a host config (no dev door, the module wrap is the only copy), non-host configs (standalone stack), artifact-only boots.

## Accepted deviations (seat ruling (a) on the card)

Parity measured on a default-compile `os dev` boot, every type `GET /api/v1/meta` lists, each `GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE` diffed per item, base vs head with only `dist/commands/serve.js` swapped. The noise floor (base vs base) is `package.installedAt/updatedAt` only.

| Project | types | items | diffs beyond noise |
|---|---|---|---|
| `examples/app-crm` + inline host marker | 34 | 198 | 2 |
| blank scaffold (template copy) | 33 | 164 | 1 |
| `examples/app-showcase` (host, `onEnable`) | 37 | 457 | 2 |

All three kinds are the compiled form of the same item, which non-host and artifact boots already serve:

1. A hook declared with a function: base served it with no `handler`/`body` (the function does not serialize); head serves the compiled `handler` name and `body`. Behaviour identical: the crm stage hook set `probability` 10 → 100 on both.
2. A connector whose `providerConfig.spec` names a file (showcase `showcase_status_openapi`): base served the authored path, head serves the document the build inlined.
3. The app's package record: `manifest.plugins` (base `[]` or `[{name, version:'0.0.0'}]`, head the build's list) and, on the showcase, `manifest.runtimeModule`.

Nothing the module wrap alone carried is lost: the showcase `onEnable` runs on head through the graft (approval-demo `sys_approval_request` rows 3 on base and head), no "no app bundle claimed" warning on any run, and boot WARN lines are identical apart from timestamps.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/test/dev-host-config-artifact-source.integration.test.ts` (integration tier; five boots on kernel-assigned ports plus one compile). One fixture, two copies: artifact compiled from ART (form closed, label `Leads ART`, `maxLength` 201), then SRC written over the config with a later mtime.

- Host, `os dev --no-compile`: STALE warning word for word; `GET /forms/SLUG` 404; `/meta/view` label ART; `/meta/object` field ART; banner `Artifact:`; module `onEnable` ran (the artifact carries none, so only the graft can have run it).
- Host, `os dev` (compiles): forms 200, label and field SRC, no STALE warning, the source's function hook fires on insert (`score` 42), `onEnable` ran.
- CONTROLS: host `os start` (forms 200 = SRC, banner `Config:`, `onEnable` ran); non-host `os dev --no-compile` (ART for all three, banner `Artifact:`); artifact-only `os start` (ART).

Forced changes to existing pins (both pinned the two-copy boot this PR removes):

- `test/serve-dev-connector-env-parity.integration.test.ts`, the `os dev --no-compile` leg: `materialized` was pinned NOT to be the build-time `baseUrl` (dispatch read the module copy while `/meta` read the artifact). Dispatch now reads the same artifact, so it is pinned to the build-time value: the two copies agree, which is that file's stated property.
- `test/artifact-flag-precedence.integration.test.ts`, the bare `os start` beside a host config: that harness runs the tsx source entry with `NODE_ENV=development`, so its `os start` composes the dev artifact door, and the ready row now names `dist/objectstack.json`, where the app was registered from. The production `os start` row (`Config:`) is held by the new file's shipped-entry CONTROL. Header paragraph updated to match.
- `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs` self-test: the new file joins the pinned built-entry census (its CONTROL legs need production posture, which `bin/run-dev.js` cannot give); the label now reads twenty-one. The new file's spawn puts `NODE_ENV: undefined` after the leg's env spread so no leg can override it.

## Acceptance notes

- Before the fix, `/meta/object` on the crm-shaped fixture already answered the artifact, while the blank scaffold's object answered the source (`blank_note.title.maxLength` 202 on base, 201 on head with `--no-compile`). The pin asserts ART for objects on head; on base it happened to pass for this fixture.

## Verification

<details><summary>Red on base, green on head, wrap-back ablation</summary>

Base (`dist/commands/serve.js` from 2b752aa4f) — 3 failed | 10 passed:

```text
× the public form door answers the artifact (form closed there), not the edited source  — expected 200 to be 404
× /meta/view serves the artifact's list label  — expected [ 'Leads SRC' ] to deeply equal [ 'Leads ART' ]
× the ready banner names the artifact  — expected 'config' to be 'artifact'
```

Head: 13 passed.

Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `artifactBundle ?? config,` → `config,`, cli rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/cli 'artifactBundle ?? config' --absent` → marker absent from all 456 built files) — 2 failed | 11 passed:

```text
× the public form door answers the artifact ...  — expected 200 to be 404
× /meta/view serves the artifact's list label  — expected [ 'Leads SRC' ] to deeply equal [ 'Leads ART' ]
```

Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt, preflight finds the marker in `dist/commands/serve.js`.

</details>

<details><summary>Controls A/B on examples/app-crm</summary>

- Non-host `os dev --no-compile` over a stale artifact: base vs head per-item `/meta` diff = 0 items beyond the timestamp noise (34 types, 199 items); forms 404, label ART, field 201 on both.
- Host `os start` over a stale artifact: forms 200 and banner `Config:` on both.

</details>

<details><summary>Local test and gate readings at 36249b9d7</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration` (whole tier, at 3ab4a5b6; the later commit only reorders one spawn env key in the new file and adds the census row): 211 passed, 2 skipped files; 1914 passed, 10 skipped tests. The new file re-run at 36249b9d7: 13 passed.
- `--project unit` (whole tier, at 30700dae + the new test, after `OS_SKIP_DTS` builds): 400 passed, 6 failed; the 6 were `.d.ts`-dependent (scaffold typecheck, published-subpath, released-port census). After a full build with declarations, the five `.d.ts` files re-ran 58/58 green; the released-port census went green once the new file moved to kernel-assigned ports.
- `pnpm build` (full, 119 tasks) then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` green; `check:test-typecheck` green (needed `--max-old-space-size=6144`, it ran out of heap at the default).
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over `packages/cli` and `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (6 paths vs merge base 2b752aa4f): 90 derived, 90 run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 90 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>
